Chemistry (BS/MS)

Dornsife College of Letters, Arts and Sciences

Overview

This combined program allows exceptional students to earn both the Bachelor of Science and the Master of Science in Chemistry in five years. Students apply to the combined degree during the junior year of the undergraduate program.

Degree Requirements

Students complete all requirements of the BS in Chemistry plus 24 graduate units, including CHEM 538 Advanced Physical Chemistry (4 units) and a master's thesis. A cumulative GPA of 3.4 is required for continuation into the graduate year.
